resources.string: For a hub published behind Cloudflare Access. Create a service token in Cloudflare Zero Trust and add it to a Service Auth policy of the hub\'s application. Only this hub\'s requests carry it.
Only for a hub behind Cloudflare Access: enter its service token before connecting, or the first request is already turned away.
Couldn\'t save the service token. Try again.
This hub is behind Cloudflare Access and needs a service token. Enter its Client ID and Client Secret under Cloudflare Access, then connect again.
Cloudflare Access rejected the service token. Check the Client ID and Client Secret, and that the hub\'s Access policy includes this token.
